blocks.html: Outside openings accessible to the Fire Department and that open directly on a hoistway or shaftway communicating between two or more floors in a building shall be plainly marked with the word "SHAFTWAY" in red letters not less than 6 inches (152.4 mm) high on a white background. Such warning signs shall be placed so as to be readily discernible from the outside of the building.
